decision_rule.summary: Compute seven normalized terms and assign the high-consistency label when the score is at least 90, all six positive terms pass, and R is below 0.05.

provenance.notes: Computed from local CSX-237 records only.

criteria.description: Returns seven ledger rows plus score, positive-term count, rainfall pass flag, and final label.
criteria.name: JSON ledger completeness
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly complete structure with missing rows or missing summary fields.

criteria.description: Parses M8.8, alert score 3, 35 km depth, runner-up magnitude 5.7, five precipitation values, 0 pre and 0 post radar counts, population 5823675.13, and amenity count 1000.
criteria.name: Raw value parsing
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for most anchors with minor rounding mistakes, and 1 point for a few correct anchors.

criteria.description: Computes S=0.867, K=0.886, Z=1.000, V=1.000, X=0.966, F=0.833, and R=0.019 within tolerance.
criteria.name: Normalized terms
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct terms with one or two formula errors.

criteria.description: Applies the stated coefficients and reports 92.0 points out of 100 within 0.1.
criteria.name: Weighted score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right formula with arithmetic or rounding errors.

criteria.description: Marks all six positive terms as passing and marks the rainfall term as passing.
criteria.name: Threshold logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the final label is right but one threshold result is missing or wrong.

criteria.description: Assigns high_consistency_catalog_led_record from the score and threshold gates.
criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct score with an incorrect or missing label.

criteria.description: Uses compact numeric wording and clear units.
criteria.name: Numeric clarity
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for minor formatting issues that do not change the result.
